title: [References to Judicial Magistrate of the first class in sections 108, 109 and 110 of the Code of
text:
72. [References to Judicial Magistrate of the first class in sections 108, 109 and 110 of the Code of

_Criminal Procedure, 1973 not to be construed as references to an Executive Magistrate.]_ _Omitted by the_
_Code of Criminal Procedure (Amendment) Act, 1980 (63 of 1980), s. 9 (w.e.f. 23-9-1980)._

CHAPTER IX

SPECIAL POWERS UNDER THE PREVENTION OF CRUELTY TO ANIMALS ACT, 1960
